readmeExcerpt: This is a crude translation from th C implementation of libquantum to a Java version. The main idea is to be able to work with CNOT / Toffoli and other gates that are not necessary to use superposition. LibQuantumJava supports up to 2048 qubits, the "C implementation" covers only 128 qubits.
